restrictions: Messages are exactly 128 bytes, encoded from 4 independent uniform 256-bit words.
One batch of exactly n = 2^129 samples (an integer loop bound); all repeated messages are retained and charged; no restart or success amplification.
One selected 5-round compression or permutation per sample; single padded block or rate block; no parent or extra compression is ever evaluated.

Collision detection by deterministic stable LSD radix sort of the full 256-bit digest (eight 32-bit digit passes, 2^32 native 256-bit word counters that cannot overflow, prefix positions up to n) followed by one linear scan; no hash table, no probing, and no distributional premise on digests.

Every ledger entry is a deterministic worst-case bound over all coin sequences and every fixed target; loads, additions and stores of counter and position updates are charged separately; no expected value appears anywhere.
Classical 256-bit word RAM with independent uniform random words; all initialization, sorting, scanning and verification charged.
Analytical generic construction; no full-scale execution, precomputed collision, or empirical heuristic is claimed.
The nominal reference identifier does not assert an improvement; the conservative scalar bound is 129.27.
